sync_akeneo.setup.credentials.step1: In Akeneo, open 设置 -> Connections 和 create a 新建 API connection or connected app 用于 Helios.
sync_akeneo.setup.credentials.step2: Copy the Akeneo base URL, client id, 和 client secret into the 集成 credentials tab in Helios.
sync_akeneo.setup.credentials.step3: 创建 a dedicated Akeneo API user, assign it to the right catalog permissions, 和 use that username/password in the credential 用于m.
sync_akeneo.setup.credentials.step4: Grant the API user access to products, categories, attributes, families, family variants, locales, 和 channels. Limit write permissions if you only import.
sync_akeneo.setup.credentials.title: 创建 API credentials in Akeneo
sync_akeneo.setup.docs.note1: Akeneo authentication uses client id, client secret, username, 和 password. Helios exchanges those 用于 access/refresh tokens automatically.
sync_akeneo.setup.docs.note2: For large catalogs, keep batch sizes at 100 和 prefer incremental product syncs. The importer resumes 从 the last processed Akeneo updated timestamp plus search_after pagination state.
sync_akeneo.setup.docs.note3: Simple Akeneo products still create a default Helios variant. Variant Akeneo products flatten the full Akeneo product-model tree into one configurable product plus child variants.
sync_akeneo.setup.docs.note4: If you want channel offers 和 prices, create matching 销售 Channels 和 目录 Price Kinds in Helios first, then reference their codes in the mapping blocks below.
